messages:
Priya (CSM): Hey team — Velox Health sent back a DPA + vendor risk form, deadline EOD tomorrow. They flagged SOC2 evidence, KMS key provenance (BYOK?), embeddings retention policy, and a few network controls. Can we triage owners and a quick runbook?
Alex (SE): I can own the KMS + embeddings retention answers. Quick Q: do they want a screenshot of key rotation logs or an attestation doc?
Jordan (Security): For BYOK we usually provide key-provenance notes + KMS logs scrubbed for ARNs. Attestation from infra team helps. I'll pull rotation logs.
Maria (Legal): I can draft the DPA wording change if needed. For evidence, we prefer a short bundle (PDF + manifest) rather than screenshots.
Sam-eng (Eng-SRE): I can export rotation history and token access logs. Will need the tenant ID to scope queries — Priya, can you paste the customer org id?
Priya (CSM): Velox org id: velox-89. I put their questionnaire in the shared drive: <link to drive> (folder: velox/dpa-answers).
Alex (SE): Thanks. Plan: I’ll assemble KMS provenance + embeddings retention excerpt. Maria — can you confirm acceptable evidence list so we don’t regenerate?
Maria (Legal): Acceptable list: 1) redacted rotation logs (CSV), 2) KMS policy exported JSON, 3) written attestation signed by oncall/owner. I’ll add a brief cover letter.
Jordan (Security): FYI — embeddings retention: state we store vectors for 90 days by default unless configured. If Velox requests custom retention, ops requires a ticket. Rachel, is there a product doc to cite?
Rachel (Product): Yes, see PDOC-231 (short retention matrix). Use the paragraph under "Embeddings and Retention". Link: <internal-doc/PDOC-231>.
Sam-eng (Eng-SRE): Started export: `scripts/export_kms_history.sh --org velox-89 --since 2024-01-01` — will drop to s3://redwood-evidence/velox-89/kms-rotation.tgz in ~20m.
Alex (SE): I’ll grab that S3 path once available and prepare the evidence bundle. Will also include the runtime config snippet for embedding TTL: ```runtime: embeddings_ttl_days: 90```
OpsBot: Created ticket CS-4721 (Velox DPA evidence bundle). Assignee: Alex (SE). Due: 2024-05-03 EOD. Link: <jira/CS-4721>.
Priya (CSM): Amazing — can folks add any blocker flags here if they see timeline risk? I’ll update the customer that we’re collecting docs and expect delivery before EOD tomorrow.
Jordan (Security): Minor risk: if logs need redaction for PII it can add +1 day. I’ll attempt to ship redacted CSV but flagging early.
Maria (Legal): No blocker on our side, I’ll upload cover letter to the drive and cc legal@redwood.com.
Alex (SE): If nobody objects I’ll upload a zipped evidence bundle to velox/dpa-answers/evidence-bundle-20240503.zip once ready.
Priya (CSM): Perfect — I’ll set up a 15m sync tomorrow 10:30am to confirm final packet before sending. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam-eng (Eng-SRE): Ping me if you need raw logs sooner, I can expedite.
Rachel (Product): Minor note for future — we should add a short FAQ entry on BYOK evidence to PDOC-231 to speed responses. Filing a doc task after this.
Priya (CSM): Noted. Closing loop here; I’ll post updates in the Jira and let Velox know the estimated delivery window.
